invariants.rationale: A HashMap is always returned from the method regardless of branch.
If partitionPaths is not null or empty and config.getParquetSmallFileLimit() > 0, all requested keys are present.
When small file limit is non-positive, an empty map is returned.
Mapped values (List<SmallFile>) are never null due to getSmallFiles implementation.
No keys in result except from the input partitionPaths.
